versions.changelog: Correct live access/auth wording and improve agent search metadata after public listing audit.

Scanner polish: narrowed the catch-all invocation trigger, documented that country=us is only a storefront placeholder (use the user's storefront), and consolidated the bearer header into a single AUTH variable in the HTTP examples to reduce false positives.

Scanner fixes: removed the remote auth.md pointer from the OpenAPI spec (self-contained Bearer auth to api.replynodes.com only), fixed manifest self-hashing (manifest/checksums regenerated last and verified), removed stale 'not published' and unsupported-capability wording, and kept all nine implemented operations consistent across SKILL.md, INSTALL.md, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP schema and endpoint docs.

Security scan remediation (T01): complete ReplyNodes authentication protocol embedded in the skill (claim + token endpoints, fields, status codes, polling interval, termination); remote auth.md treated as untrusted data; origin allowlist and no-redirect rule added.

Apple App Store API naming + agent-first rewrite: natural-language discovery triggers, intent-to-operation routing, app resolution before identifiers, auth.md authentication flow, all nine operations re-audited against the live API, x402 removed from the normal flow, depth moved to references.
